verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs mention running scheduled Python jobs for ingest/transformation (docs-3) and dbt integration supporting incremental models (docs-7/19/32), which gives some incremental transformation capability, but there is no evidence of native streaming primitives, continuous queries, declarative pipeline objects, or task/stream constructs (à la Snowflake Streams & Tasks or Materialize) — MotherDuck is positioned as a serverless analytical warehouse, not a streaming engine. Missing for 10: native stream/CDC ingestion, continuous query execution, declarative pipeline DSL, task scheduling beyond generic Python cron jobs, and any independent evidence of these being used for continuous transformations.
